articles.title: Digital Payment Today - OwlTing Expands Digital Payment Reach with New Enterprise Clients
articles.mainIdea: Digital Payment Today - OwlTing Expands Digital Payment Reach with New Enterprise Clients
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Digital Payment Today - OwlTing Expands Digital Payment Reach with New Enterprise Clients. OwlTing Group has announced significant strides in its digital payment platform, OwlPay Harbor, by securing over 20 enterprise clients in the first quarter of 2026. These clients, which include fintech, remittance, nonprofit, and cross-border B2B payment services, represent over $5 billion in annual payment volume. This development marks a critical phase in OwlTing's transformation into a fully operational monetization entity, leveraging a regulated digital currency settlement infrastructure... Related tickers mentioned: PYPL, SOFI.

articles.title: Weekly Stock List
articles.summary: Argus Research: Weekly Stock List. Argus is hosting a five-part webinar series on AI, examining the ways that different sectors are incorporating AI practices. We recently completed our third webinar, featuring the Financial sector. AI is helping Financial companies become leaner, more efficient, and more service/customer focused. Financial sector companies tend to be big spenders on technology and have been early leaders in adopting AI practices. There are many ways these companies use AI strategies, including in back-office processes, fraud detection, compliance, improved customer service, marketing, or for completing mundane or repetitive tasks (like reading or analyzing data). Banks, brokerages, payment processors, insurance companies are some of the industries within the overall sector. For our list this week, we've put together a cheat sheet from our recent webinar, highlighting some of our BUY-rated Financial sector companies that are taking the lead in the use of AI. Related tickers mentioned: BK, BK-PK, CB, ICE, JPM, MS, MS-PQ, SPGI, TRV, XYZ.
